title: Line stability report context (all fields optional)

group_filter.description: When group_col is set, restrict the assessment to this group value.

start.description: Period start (ISO datetime or numeric consistent with the time column).

parameter_cols.description: Pin process-parameter columns; default = all numeric columns.

inspection_cols.description: Quality/inspection columns (also used as contribution-analysis targets).

spec_limits.description: Per-parameter spec limits enabling Cpk/Ppk capability findings.

weights.description: Per-parameter weights for the composite score; default = ontology-role adaptive (quality/inspection signals x2) when available, else equal weights.

scenario.description: Free-text scenario of the analyzed system (e.g. production line, energy/HVAC system, lab process). Drives the adaptive narrative subject; inferred from the ontology scene when omitted.

objective.description: What the user wants this analysis to answer; surfaced in the report hero as the analysis objective.

action_log.description: tuning-memory action_log.json; requires a run-dir layout for attribution.

doe_run_dir.description: doe-analyzer run dir whose conclusions/recommendations.json supplies operating windows.

preprocessing.description: Upstream preprocessing provenance (source export file, script, sha256, summary path) carried verbatim into report.data.preprocessing for the data traceability chain.

ontology_path.description: Explicit ontology.json to adopt (must exist, be valid JSON and carry scene+signals). Overridden by --ontology; when absent the ontology stage prepares a declared prior.

scene.description: Scene key for the ontology asset store lookup (same as --scene).

units.description: Declared per-column units (column -> unit). Declared units are the only units that enter the ontology as user_provided/KNOWN; columns without a declaration stay 'unit undeclared'.

mode.description: Ontology stage mode for scripts/ontology_prepare.py and the analyze-entry brief gate (ONTOLOGY_BRIEF_REQUIRED). Absent/none/off keeps the gate off.

scene_key.description: Scene key override for the ontology asset store (fallback chain: --scene > ontology.scene_key > scenario > run dir name).

ontology.description: Ontology stage directives consumed by scripts/ontology_prepare.py (prepare mode/scene) and by the analyzer's brief gate.
